data.description:
# Intake Brief — Gym Scene: Card Type Index with Synergy Groups

Work item: CG-0MTDH0R5V0094D4T

## Problem statement

Developers and designers have no way to browse the full Main Street card pool
grouped by card family, nor to see which cards contribute to each synergy type.
Card data is spread across `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` and only
surfaced piecemeal through in-game tooltips. A Gym scene that indexes every card
template — groupable by type (family) or by synergy, filterable/searchable, with
a full-data detail dialog — gives engine developers a fast reference for card
balance, synergy coverage, and data-shape inspection.

## Users

- **Engine developer / designer (primary):** browses and filters the Main Street
  card pool, inspects every raw field of a card. *"As an engine developer, I want
  to browse all Main Street cards grouped by type or synergy and see every raw
  data field, so I can audit card data and synergy coverage quickly."*
- **QA engineer (secondary):** verifies the index reflects the CSV data exactly
  (counts, groupings, fields).

## Answers from the producer (intake clarifications)

1. **Card type index** — a browsable index of all cards **grouped by type**,
   and **filterable/searchable**.
2. **Synergy groups** — a **second grouping view**. Some cards have synergies
   with more than one type, so in the synergy view a card **appears in multiple
   groups** (one group per synergy type with which it synergises).
3. **Card data source** — **Main Street cards** (`example-games/main-street/`).
4. **Card detail** — **not a second scene**; a **detail dialog** (view of the
   card) that shows **all game data**, not just what the player-facing tooltip
   shows.
5. **Filtering complexity** — **simple** (case-insensitive substring match on
   name/id plus family/synergy grouping).
6. **Tooltip / dialog mode** — **whatever Main Street uses and the core engine
   provides** (`TooltipManager` for hover tooltips; `createOverlayDialog` from
   `@ui/Overlay` for the scrollable detail dialog).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **New scene** `example-games/gym/scenes/GymCardIndexScene.ts` extending
   `GymSceneBase`, registered in `GymRegistry.ts` (scene key + catalogue entry),
   exported from `example-games/gym/index.ts`, and registered in `main.ts` (both
   import and Phaser scene array), reachable from the GymRouter.
2. **By-type grouping:** a "By Type" view groups every Main Street card template
   by card family (`business`, `community-space`, `event`, `upgrade`, `staff`),
   showing the card count per group.
3. **By-synergy grouping:** a "By Synergy" view groups cards by synergy type
   (`Food`, `Culture`, `Commerce`, `Service`, `Entertainment`, `Health`). A card
   with multiple `synergyTypes` appears in **each** matching group; cards with no
   synergy types appear in an explicit "Unsynergised" group. Group membership
   counts are shown.
4. **Filter/search:** a text filter box filters the visible cards by
   case-insensitive substring match against card name and id. Filtering applies
   in both grouping views and groups with no matching cards are hidden. A
   "[ Clear ]" control resets the filter.
5. **Card detail dialog:** clicking a card opens a scrollable detail dialog
   (`createOverlayDialog` from `@ui/Overlay`) titled with the card name, showing
   **all** data fields of the card template (family, id, name, cost, income,
   synergy types, description, tier, and every family-specific field that is
   present) — superset of the player-facing `buildCardTooltipInfo()` output. The
   dialog closes via its ✕ button and destroys all created objects.
6. **Hover tooltips:** hovering a card shows a tooltip built with the
   player-facing Main Street formatter (`buildCardTooltipInfo`) through the
   shared `TooltipManager` (the same component Main Street uses).
7. **SLL layout:** the scene defines and loads its own SLL layout JSON
   (`example-games/gym/layouts/gym-card-index.layout.json`) and resolves zone
   anchors via `anchorPoint()` — no hardcoded pixel positions for the primary
   layout anchors.
8. **Testable core logic:** grouping, filtering, and detail-field formatting are
   implemented as pure, exported functions in a module
   (`example-games/gym/GymCardIndex.ts`) so they can be unit tested without a
   browser.
9. **Automated tests:**
   - `tests/gym/GymCardIndex.test.ts` — unit tests for `groupByFamily`,
     `groupBySynergy`, `filterCards`, and `formatCardDetailLines`, including the
     multi-synergy membership case and the empty-filter/no-match cases.
   - `GymRegistry.test.ts` updated to assert the new scene key is exported and
     present in the catalogue.
   - A browser smoke test (`tests/gym/GymCardIndexScene.browser.test.ts`)
     verifying the scene boots, both grouping modes toggle, and the detail dialog
     opens with card data.
10. **Documentation:** `example-games/gym/README.md` (scene table) and
    `docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md` (scene-to-API mapping) updated; code comments on
    significant decisions.
11. **Quality gates:** `npm run build` succeeds and the unit test suite passes.

> **Note:** `CHANGELOG.md` is **excluded** — it is managed by the ship skill's
> release pipeline.

## Constraints

- Card data must be read from the existing Main Street exports
  (`getBusinessTemplates()`, `getCommunitySpaceTemplates()`, `getEventTemplates()`,
  `getUpgradeTemplates()`, `getStaffCardTemplates()`) — **no duplicated card data**
  and no edits to `card-data.csv`.
- The detail dialog must show raw template data only; it must not mutate card
  objects.
- Reuse existing shared components (`TooltipManager`, `createOverlayDialog`,
  `GymButtonBar`, `HelpPanel`) — no bespoke tooltip/dialog implementations.
- The scene must not modify Main Street code (`example-games/main-street/`) other
  than importing its public exports.
- Follow the Gym scene conventions: extend `GymSceneBase`, `initHeader()`,
  `initHelp()`, `initReducedMotion()`, SLL anchors.
- Reduced-motion must be respected (no tweened grouping transitions when
  reduced-motion is active).

## Existing state

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` exports `CardFamily`,
  `SynergyType`, `synergyColor()`, and the five template getters
  (`getBusinessTemplates()`, `getCommunitySpaceTemplates()`,
  `getEventTemplates()`, `getUpgradeTemplates()`, `getStaffCardTemplates()`),
  plus `CARD_TEMPLATE_NAMES` / `CARD_TIER_MAP`.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetFormatting.ts` exports
  `buildCardTooltipInfo(card, config)` — the player-facing tooltip text used by
  the Main Street renderer.
- `src/ui/Tooltip.ts` provides `TooltipManager` (DOM + Phaser modes); Main Street
  uses it via `MainStreetLifecycleManager`.
- `src/ui/Overlay.ts` provides `createOverlayDialog()` — a scrollable
  title/close/body dialog with `hudContainer` parenting and `close()` cleanup;
  recommended for dialogs with dynamic content.
- 23 Gym demo scenes exist and follow the `GymSceneBase` + SLL layout pattern
  (e.g. `GymRuleEngineScene`, `GymTooltipScene`, `GymTokenPileViewScene`).

## Desired change

- **`example-games/gym/GymCardIndex.ts`** (new) — pure query/format helpers:
  `buildCardIndex()` (flatten template getters into `{card, family, tier}` rows),
  `groupByFamily()`, `groupBySynergy()`, `filterCards()`, `formatCardDetailLines()`.
- **`example-games/gym/scenes/GymCardIndexScene.ts`** (new) — the scene:
  grouping-mode toggle buttons, filter input, grouped card list, hover tooltips,
  click-to-open detail dialog.
- **`example-games/gym/layouts/gym-card-index.layout.json`** (new) — SLL zones.
- **`example-games/gym/GymRegistry.ts`**, **`index.ts`**, **`main.ts`** —
  registration.
- **`tests/gym/GymCardIndex.test.ts`** (new), **`tests/gym/GymRegistry.test.ts`**
  (updated), **`tests/gym/GymCardIndexScene.browser.test.ts`** (new).
- **`example-games/gym/README.md`**, **`docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md`** — docs.

## Related work

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` — card data source.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetFormatting.ts` — `buildCardTooltipInfo`.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymTooltipScene.ts` — TooltipManager usage reference.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymRuleEngineScene.ts` — recent Gym scene template
  (layouts + button bar + event log).
- `docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md` — scene-to-API mapping to extend.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk — synergy view size:** a card in every synergy group inflates the
  by-synergy listing. Mitigation: the view is scrollable and searchable; counts
  are shown per group.
- **Risk — layout density:** ~124 card templates. Mitigation: paginate/limit
  rendered rows per group with a "showing N of M" label and rely on the search
  filter for the rest.
- **Assumption:** "type" == `CardFamily` (the CSV `family` column), and
  "synergy groups" == the six `SynergyType` values from each card's
  `synergyTypes`.
- **Assumption:** the detail dialog shows every *present* template field; absent
  optional fields are listed as "—" so the shape is explicit.
- **Scope-creep guard:** no card editing, no CSV export, no cross-game indexing —
  log such ideas as separate `discovered-from:` work items.
